import hashlib
import json
import platform
import random
import re
import statistics
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path.cwd()
WORK = ROOT / "benchmark-results/robust-2026-10-10"


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def command(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(args, text=True).strip()


def samples(label):
    result = {}
    for group in ["robust_covariance", "inference"]:
        for folder in sorted((ROOT / "target/criterion" / group).glob("*")):
            if group == "inference" and not folder.name.startswith("with_robust_se"):
                continue
            case = f"{group}/{folder.name}"
            source = folder / f"robust-{label}"
            if not source.exists():
                continue
            result[case] = {
                name: json.loads((source / f"{name}.json").read_text())
                for name in ["sample", "estimates", "benchmark", "tukey"]
            }
            sample = result[case]["sample"]
            result[case]["ns_per_call"] = [
                t / n for t, n in zip(sample["times"], sample["iters"])
            ]
    return result


labels = ["A8", "E1", "E2", "A9", "E3", "A10", "A11", "E4"]
raw = {label: samples(label) for label in labels}
assert all(len(raw[label]) == 8 for label in labels)
summary = []
rng = random.Random(261010)
for case in sorted(raw["A8"]):
    a = [raw[label][case]["ns_per_call"] for label in ["A8", "A9", "A10", "A11"]]
    c = [raw[label][case]["ns_per_call"] for label in ["E1", "E2", "E3", "E4"]]
    assert all(len(s) == 10 for s in a + c)
    baseline = statistics.median(statistics.median(s) for s in a)
    candidate = statistics.median(statistics.median(s) for s in c)

    def resample(processes):
        return statistics.median(
            statistics.median(rng.choices(rng.choice(processes), k=10))
            for _ in processes
        )

    ratios = sorted(resample(c) / resample(a) for _ in range(2000))
    summary.append({
        "case": case,
        "baseline_us": baseline / 1000,
        "candidate_us": candidate / 1000,
        "baseline_process_medians_us": [statistics.median(s) / 1000 for s in a],
        "candidate_process_medians_us": [statistics.median(s) / 1000 for s in c],
        "reduction_percent": 100 * (1 - candidate / baseline),
        "candidate_over_baseline": candidate / baseline,
        "ratio_95_interval": [ratios[49], ratios[1949]],
    })

phase_log = (WORK / "profile.log").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
profile = {}
for match in re.finditer(
    r"ROBUST_PHASE n=10000 p=48 cluster=(None|Some\(\"cluster\"\)) "
    r"design_ns=(\d+) scores_ns=(\d+) outer_ns=(\d+)", phase_log
):
    group = match.group(1)
    profile.setdefault(group, []).append({
        name: int(value) for name, value in zip(
            ["design_validation_ns", "influences_ns", "accumulation_ns"], match.groups()[1:]
        )
    })

report = {
    "schema_version": 1,
    "metadata": {
        "date": "2026-10-10",
        "baseline_revision": command("git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"),
        "rustc": command("rustc", "--version"),
        "cargo": command("cargo", "--version"),
        "platform": platform.platform(),
        "cpu": "AMD Ryzen 5 8600G, 6 cores, 12 logical processors",
        "profile": "repository bench profile (optimized, debug symbols enabled)",
        "features": "default (Argmin)",
        "threads": {k: "1" for k in ["MKL_NUM_THREADS", "OMP_NUM_THREADS", "RAYON_NUM_THREADS", "POLARS_MAX_THREADS"]},
        "LME_PERF_DIAG": "unset",
        "warmup_seconds": 2,
        "measurement_seconds": 3,
        "criterion_samples_per_case_per_process": 10,
        "process_order": labels,
        "process_order_description": "ABBA / BAAB, A=baseline, E=candidate; second block added to resolve small-call uncertainty, retaining all first-block measurements",
        "seed": 261010,
        "metric": "median of four process medians of sample-average ns per operation",
        "bootstrap": "2000 hierarchical draws, resampling processes and ten samples within each selected process, seed 261010, empirical 2.5/97.5 percentiles",
        "timing_boundary": "robust_covariance: complete compute_robust_se plus result destruction; input construction and fitting excluded. inference controls: existing batched with_robust_se, fit cloning excluded.",
        "workloads": "Seed 261010, OLS y ~ x1 + ...; (180 rows, 2 coefficients), (10000, 16), (10000, 48); HC0 or 100 cyclic string clusters. Existing sleepstudy REML LMM controls have 180 rows, 2 coefficients and 18 Subject clusters.",
        "binary_sha256": {name: digest(WORK / filename) for name, filename in [
            ("baseline", "baseline-final.exe"), ("candidate", "candidate.exe"),
            ("profile", "profile.exe"), ("rejected_iterator", "rejected-iterator.exe"),
            ("rejected_indexed", "rejected-indexed.exe"),
            ("rejected_validation_prototype", "rejected-validation-prototype.exe"),
            ("initial_probe", "baseline.exe"),
        ]},
        "baseline_source_sha256": digest(WORK / "baseline-robust.rs"),
        "candidate_source_sha256": digest(ROOT / "src/robust.rs"),
        "harness_source_sha256": digest(ROOT / "benches/bench_math.rs"),
        "cargo_lock_sha256": digest(ROOT / "Cargo.lock"),
        "sleepstudy_input_sha256": digest(ROOT / "tests/data/sleepstudy.csv"),
        "correctness_test_sha256": digest(ROOT / "tests/test_robust.rs"),
        "correctness_test_patch": command("git", "diff", "--", "tests/test_robust.rs"),
        "candidate_patch": command("git", "diff", "--", "src/robust.rs"),
        "harness_patch": command("git", "diff", "--", "benches/bench_math.rs"),
        "build_command": "cargo bench --locked --bench bench_math --no-run",
        "run_command": "<retained executable> --bench 'robust_covariance|inference/with_robust_se' --noplot --warm-up-time 2 --measurement-time 3 --save-baseline robust-<label>",
        "collector_source": Path(__file__).read_text(),
    },
    "summary": summary,
    "raw_sessions": raw,
    "session_logs": {label: (WORK / f"{label}.log").read_text(encoding="utf-8") for label in labels},
    "attribution": {
        "method": "temporary Instant timers in actual baseline compute_robust_se; a separate instrumented executable, excluded from throughput comparison",
        "run_command": "profile.exe --bench 'robust_covariance/.*10000_rows_48' --noplot --warm-up-time 0.1 --measurement-time 0.1 --save-baseline robust-profile",
        "patch": (WORK / "profile.patch").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"),
        "raw_phase_samples": profile,
        "log": phase_log,
    },
    "rejected_experiments": {
        "validation_prototype": {
            "reason": "Wider calls improved, but moving the narrow fallback into a helper regressed small HC0 controls by 6.8% and 14.2%. Restored original inline fallback, separated row buffers into a non-inlined helper.",
            "report": json.loads((WORK / "validation-prototype-report.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")),
        },
        "indexed_triangle": {
            "reason": "Large HC0 gain was inconclusive (ratio interval 0.892-1.048); small LMM HC0 control regressed 5.3% (interval 1.004-1.071). Removed and kept original covariance accumulation.",
            "report": json.loads((WORK / "indexed-report.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")),
        },
        "iterator_candidate": {
            "reason": "correctness passed, but complete-call latency regressed substantially; removed",
            "patch": (WORK / "rejected-iterator.patch").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"),
            "raw_samples": samples("B1"),
            "log": (WORK / "B1.log").read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
        },
        "initial_probe": {
            "reason": "Standalone reference accumulation measured longer than the entire operation; not valid phase attribution. Removed its benchmark and replaced it with actual routine timers. Initial throughput samples excluded from primary comparison because common harness changed before retained final baseline.",
            "raw_samples": samples("A1"),
            "log": (WORK / "A1.log").read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
        },
    },
    "limits": ["single Windows machine", "four processes per version", "no cross-library or complete-fit speed claim", "four heavy production tests not run"],
}
out = ROOT / "benchmarks/perf-tune-robust-covariance-2026-10-10.json"
out.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
for row in summary:
    print(row["case"], f'{row["baseline_us"]:.3f} -> {row["candidate_us"]:.3f} us, {row["reduction_percent"]:.1f}% reduction, CI {row["ratio_95_interval"]}')
for cluster, values in profile.items():
    print("PHASE", cluster, {key: statistics.median(v[key] for v in values) / 1e6 for key in values[0]})

import hashlib
import json
import platform
import random
import re
import statistics
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path.cwd()
WORK = ROOT / "benchmark-results/robust-2026-10-10"


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def command(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(args, text=True).strip()


def samples(label):
    result = {}
    for group in ["robust_covariance", "inference"]:
        for folder in sorted((ROOT / "target/criterion" / group).glob("*")):
            if group == "inference" and not folder.name.startswith("with_robust_se"):
                continue
            case = f"{group}/{folder.name}"
            source = folder / f"robust-{label}"
            if not source.exists():
                continue
            result[case] = {
                name: json.loads((source / f"{name}.json").read_text())
                for name in ["sample", "estimates", "benchmark", "tukey"]
            }
            sample = result[case]["sample"]
            result[case]["ns_per_call"] = [
                t / n for t, n in zip(sample["times"], sample["iters"])
            ]
    return result


labels = ["A6", "D1", "D2", "A7"]
raw = {label: samples(label) for label in labels}
assert all(len(raw[label]) == 8 for label in labels)
summary = []
rng = random.Random(261010)
for case in sorted(raw["A6"]):
    a = [raw[label][case]["ns_per_call"] for label in ["A6", "A7"]]
    c = [raw[label][case]["ns_per_call"] for label in ["D1", "D2"]]
    assert all(len(s) == 10 for s in a + c)
    baseline = statistics.median(statistics.median(s) for s in a)
    candidate = statistics.median(statistics.median(s) for s in c)

    def resample(processes):
        return statistics.median(
            statistics.median(rng.choices(rng.choice(processes), k=10))
            for _ in processes
        )

    ratios = sorted(resample(c) / resample(a) for _ in range(2000))
    summary.append({
        "case": case,
        "baseline_us": baseline / 1000,
        "candidate_us": candidate / 1000,
        "baseline_process_medians_us": [statistics.median(s) / 1000 for s in a],
        "candidate_process_medians_us": [statistics.median(s) / 1000 for s in c],
        "reduction_percent": 100 * (1 - candidate / baseline),
        "candidate_over_baseline": candidate / baseline,
        "ratio_95_interval": [ratios[49], ratios[1949]],
    })

phase_log = (WORK / "profile.log").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
profile = {}
for match in re.finditer(
    r"ROBUST_PHASE n=10000 p=48 cluster=(None|Some\(\"cluster\"\)) "
    r"design_ns=(\d+) scores_ns=(\d+) outer_ns=(\d+)", phase_log
):
    group = match.group(1)
    profile.setdefault(group, []).append({
        name: int(value) for name, value in zip(
            ["design_validation_ns", "influences_ns", "accumulation_ns"], match.groups()[1:]
        )
    })

report = {
    "schema_version": 1,
    "metadata": {
        "date": "2026-10-10",
        "baseline_revision": command("git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"),
        "rustc": command("rustc", "--version"),
        "cargo": command("cargo", "--version"),
        "platform": platform.platform(),
        "cpu": "AMD Ryzen 5 8600G, 6 cores, 12 logical processors",
        "profile": "repository bench profile (optimized, debug symbols enabled)",
        "features": "default (Argmin)",
        "threads": {k: "1" for k in ["MKL_NUM_THREADS", "OMP_NUM_THREADS", "RAYON_NUM_THREADS", "POLARS_MAX_THREADS"]},
        "LME_PERF_DIAG": "unset",
        "warmup_seconds": 2,
        "measurement_seconds": 3,
        "criterion_samples_per_case_per_process": 10,
        "process_order": labels,
        "process_order_description": "ABBA, A=baseline, D=candidate",
        "seed": 261010,
        "metric": "median of two process medians of sample-average ns per operation",
        "bootstrap": "2000 hierarchical draws, resampling processes and ten samples within each selected process, seed 261010, empirical 2.5/97.5 percentiles",
        "timing_boundary": "robust_covariance: complete compute_robust_se plus result destruction; input construction and fitting excluded. inference controls: existing batched with_robust_se, fit cloning excluded.",
        "workloads": "Seed 261010, OLS y ~ x1 + ...; (180 rows, 2 coefficients), (10000, 16), (10000, 48); HC0 or 100 cyclic string clusters. Existing sleepstudy REML LMM controls have 180 rows, 2 coefficients and 18 Subject clusters.",
        "binary_sha256": {name: digest(WORK / filename) for name, filename in [
            ("baseline", "baseline-final.exe"), ("candidate", "candidate.exe"),
            ("profile", "profile.exe"), ("rejected_iterator", "rejected-iterator.exe"),
            ("rejected_indexed", "rejected-indexed.exe"),
            ("initial_probe", "baseline.exe"),
        ]},
        "baseline_source_sha256": digest(WORK / "baseline-robust.rs"),
        "candidate_source_sha256": digest(ROOT / "src/robust.rs"),
        "harness_source_sha256": digest(ROOT / "benches/bench_math.rs"),
        "cargo_lock_sha256": digest(ROOT / "Cargo.lock"),
        "candidate_patch": command("git", "diff", "--", "src/robust.rs"),
        "harness_patch": command("git", "diff", "--", "benches/bench_math.rs"),
        "build_command": "cargo bench --locked --bench bench_math --no-run",
        "run_command": "<retained executable> --bench 'robust_covariance|inference/with_robust_se' --noplot --warm-up-time 2 --measurement-time 3 --save-baseline robust-<label>",
        "collector_source": Path(__file__).read_text(),
    },
    "summary": summary,
    "raw_sessions": raw,
    "session_logs": {label: (WORK / f"{label}.log").read_text(encoding="utf-8") for label in labels},
    "attribution": {
        "method": "temporary Instant timers in actual baseline compute_robust_se; a separate instrumented executable, excluded from throughput comparison",
        "run_command": "profile.exe --bench 'robust_covariance/.*10000_rows_48' --noplot --warm-up-time 0.1 --measurement-time 0.1 --save-baseline robust-profile",
        "patch": (WORK / "profile.patch").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"),
        "raw_phase_samples": profile,
        "log": phase_log,
    },
    "rejected_experiments": {
        "indexed_triangle": {
            "reason": "Large HC0 gain was inconclusive (ratio interval 0.892-1.048); small LMM HC0 control regressed 5.3% (interval 1.004-1.071). Removed and kept original covariance accumulation.",
            "report": json.loads((WORK / "indexed-report.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")),
        },
        "iterator_candidate": {
            "reason": "correctness passed, but complete-call latency regressed substantially; removed",
            "patch": (WORK / "rejected-iterator.patch").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"),
            "raw_samples": samples("B1"),
            "log": (WORK / "B1.log").read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
        },
        "initial_probe": {
            "reason": "Standalone reference accumulation measured longer than the entire operation; not valid phase attribution. Removed its benchmark and replaced it with actual routine timers. Initial throughput samples excluded from primary comparison because common harness changed before retained final baseline.",
            "raw_samples": samples("A1"),
            "log": (WORK / "A1.log").read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
        },
    },
    "limits": ["single Windows machine", "two processes per version", "no cross-library or complete-fit speed claim", "four heavy production tests not run"],
}
out = ROOT / "benchmarks/perf-tune-robust-covariance-2026-10-10.json"
out.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
for row in summary:
    print(row["case"], f'{row["baseline_us"]:.3f} -> {row["candidate_us"]:.3f} us, {row["reduction_percent"]:.1f}% reduction, CI {row["ratio_95_interval"]}')
for cluster, values in profile.items():
    print("PHASE", cluster, {key: statistics.median(v[key] for v in values) / 1e6 for key in values[0]})

import hashlib
import json
import platform
import random
import re
import statistics
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path.cwd()
WORK = ROOT / "benchmark-results/robust-2026-10-10"


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def command(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(args, text=True).strip()


def samples(label):
    result = {}
    for group in ["robust_covariance", "inference"]:
        for folder in sorted((ROOT / "target/criterion" / group).glob("*")):
            if group == "inference" and not folder.name.startswith("with_robust_se"):
                continue
            case = f"{group}/{folder.name}"
            source = folder / f"robust-{label}"
            if not source.exists():
                continue
            result[case] = {
                name: json.loads((source / f"{name}.json").read_text())
                for name in ["sample", "estimates", "benchmark", "tukey"]
            }
            sample = result[case]["sample"]
            result[case]["ns_per_call"] = [
                t / n for t, n in zip(sample["times"], sample["iters"])
            ]
    return result


labels = ["A2", "C1", "C2", "A3", "A4", "C3", "C4", "A5"]
raw = {label: samples(label) for label in labels}
assert all(len(raw[label]) == 8 for label in labels)
summary = []
rng = random.Random(261010)
for case in sorted(raw["A2"]):
    a = [raw[label][case]["ns_per_call"] for label in ["A2", "A3", "A4", "A5"]]
    c = [raw[label][case]["ns_per_call"] for label in ["C1", "C2", "C3", "C4"]]
    assert all(len(s) == 10 for s in a + c)
    baseline = statistics.median(statistics.median(s) for s in a)
    candidate = statistics.median(statistics.median(s) for s in c)

    def resample(processes):
        return statistics.median(
            statistics.median(rng.choices(rng.choice(processes), k=10))
            for _ in processes
        )

    ratios = sorted(resample(c) / resample(a) for _ in range(2000))
    summary.append({
        "case": case,
        "baseline_us": baseline / 1000,
        "candidate_us": candidate / 1000,
        "baseline_process_medians_us": [statistics.median(s) / 1000 for s in a],
        "candidate_process_medians_us": [statistics.median(s) / 1000 for s in c],
        "reduction_percent": 100 * (1 - candidate / baseline),
        "candidate_over_baseline": candidate / baseline,
        "ratio_95_interval": [ratios[49], ratios[1949]],
    })

phase_log = (WORK / "profile.log").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
profile = {}
for match in re.finditer(
    r"ROBUST_PHASE n=10000 p=48 cluster=(None|Some\(\"cluster\"\)) "
    r"design_ns=(\d+) scores_ns=(\d+) outer_ns=(\d+)", phase_log
):
    group = match.group(1)

        "timing_boundary": "robust_covariance: complete compute_robust_se plus result destruction; input construction and fitting excluded. inference controls: existing batched with_robust_se, fit cloning excluded.",
        "workloads": "Seed 261010, OLS y ~ x1 + ...; (180 rows, 2 coefficients), (10000, 16), (10000, 48); HC0 or 100 cyclic string clusters. Existing sleepstudy REML LMM controls have 180 rows, 2 coefficients and 18 Subject clusters.",
        "binary_sha256": {name: digest(WORK / filename) for name, filename in [
            ("baseline", "baseline-final.exe"), ("candidate", "candidate.exe"),
            ("profile", "profile.exe"), ("rejected_iterator", "rejected-iterator.exe"),
            ("initial_probe", "baseline.exe"),
        ]},
        "baseline_source_sha256": digest(WORK / "baseline-robust.rs"),
        "candidate_source_sha256": digest(ROOT / "src/robust.rs"),
        "harness_source_sha256": digest(ROOT / "benches/bench_math.rs"),

}
out = ROOT / "benchmarks/perf-tune-robust-covariance-2026-10-10.json"

import hashlib
import json
import platform
import random
import re
import statistics
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path.cwd()
WORK = ROOT / "benchmark-results/robust-2026-10-10"


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def command(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(args, text=True).strip()


def samples(label):
    result = {}
    for group in ["robust_covariance", "inference"]:
        for folder in sorted((ROOT / "target/criterion" / group).glob("*")):
            if group == "inference" and not folder.name.startswith("with_robust_se"):
                continue
            case = f"{group}/{folder.name}"
            source = folder / f"robust-{label}"
            if not source.exists():
                continue
            result[case] = {
                name: json.loads((source / f"{name}.json").read_text())
                for name in ["sample", "estimates", "benchmark", "tukey"]
            }
            sample = result[case]["sample"]
            result[case]["ns_per_call"] = [
                t / n for t, n in zip(sample["times"], sample["iters"])
            ]
    return result


labels = ["A2", "C1", "C2", "A3", "A4", "C3", "C4", "A5"]
raw = {label: samples(label) for label in labels}
assert all(len(raw[label]) == 8 for label in labels)
summary = []
rng = random.Random(261010)
for case in sorted(raw["A2"]):
    a = [raw[label][case]["ns_per_call"] for label in ["A2", "A3", "A4", "A5"]]
    c = [raw[label][case]["ns_per_call"] for label in ["C1", "C2", "C3", "C4"]]
    assert all(len(s) == 10 for s in a + c)
    baseline = statistics.median(statistics.median(s) for s in a)
    candidate = statistics.median(statistics.median(s) for s in c)

    def resample(processes):
        return statistics.median(
            statistics.median(rng.choices(rng.choice(processes), k=10))
            for _ in processes
        )

    ratios = sorted(resample(c) / resample(a) for _ in range(2000))
    summary.append({
        "case": case,
        "baseline_us": baseline / 1000,
        "candidate_us": candidate / 1000,
        "baseline_process_medians_us": [statistics.median(s) / 1000 for s in a],
        "candidate_process_medians_us": [statistics.median(s) / 1000 for s in c],
        "reduction_percent": 100 * (1 - candidate / baseline),
        "candidate_over_baseline": candidate / baseline,
        "ratio_95_interval": [ratios[49], ratios[1949]],
    })

phase_log = (WORK / "profile.log").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
profile = {}
for match in re.finditer(
    r"ROBUST_PHASE n=10000 p=48 cluster=(None|Some\(\"cluster\"\)) "
    r"design_ns=(\d+) scores_ns=(\d+) outer_ns=(\d+)", phase_log
):
    group = match.group(1)
    profile.setdefault(group, []).append({
        name: int(value) for name, value in zip(
            ["design_validation_ns", "influences_ns", "accumulation_ns"], match.groups()[1:]
        )
    })

report = {
    "schema_version": 1,
    "metadata": {
        "date": "2026-10-10",
        "baseline_revision": command("git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"),
        "rustc": command("rustc", "--version"),

        "profile": "repository bench profile (optimized, debug symbols enabled)",
        "features": "default (Argmin)",
        "threads": {k: "1" for k in ["MKL_NUM_THREADS", "OMP_NUM_THREADS", "RAYON_NUM_THREADS", "POLARS_MAX_THREADS"]},
        "LME_PERF_DIAG": "unset",
        "warmup_seconds": 2,

        "process_order": labels,

        "seed": 261010,
        "metric": "median of four process medians of sample-average ns per operation",
        "bootstrap": "2000 hierarchical draws, resampling processes and ten samples within each selected process, seed 261010, empirical 2.5/97.5 percentiles",
        "timing_boundary": "robust_covariance: complete compute_robust_se plus result destruction; input construction and fitting excluded. inference controls: existing batched with_robust_se, fit cloning excluded.",
        "workloads": "Seed 261010, OLS y ~ x1 + ...; (180 rows, 2 coefficients), (10000, 16), (10000, 48); HC0 or 100 cyclic string clusters. Existing sleepstudy REML LMM controls have 180 rows, 2 coefficients and 18 Subject clusters.",
        "binary_sha256": {name: digest(WORK / filename) for name, filename in [
            ("baseline", "baseline-final.exe"), ("candidate", "candidate.exe"),
            ("profile", "profile.exe"), ("rejected_iterator", "rejected-iterator.exe"),
            ("initial_probe", "baseline.exe"),
        ]},
        "baseline_source_sha256": digest(WORK / "baseline-robust.rs"),
        "candidate_source_sha256": digest(ROOT / "src/robust.rs"),
        "harness_source_sha256": digest(ROOT / "benches/bench_math.rs"),
        "cargo_lock_sha256": digest(ROOT / "Cargo.lock"),
        "candidate_patch": command("git", "diff", "--", "src/robust.rs"),
        "harness_patch": command("git", "diff", "--", "benches/bench_math.rs"),
        "build_command": "cargo bench --locked --bench bench_math --no-run",
        "run_command": "<retained executable> --bench 'robust_covariance|inference/with_robust_se' --noplot --warm-up-time 2 --measurement-time 3 --save-baseline robust-<label>",
        "collector_source": Path(__file__).read_text(),
    },

    "attribution": {
        "method": "temporary Instant timers in actual baseline compute_robust_se; a separate instrumented executable, excluded from throughput comparison",
        "run_command": "profile.exe --bench 'robust_covariance/.*10000_rows_48' --noplot --warm-up-time 0.1 --measurement-time 0.1 --save-baseline robust-profile",
        "patch": (WORK / "profile.patch").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"),

    },

            "reason": "correctness passed, but complete-call latency regressed substantially; removed",

            "raw_samples": samples("B1"),
            "log": (WORK / "B1.log").read_text(encoding="utf-8"),

            "reason": "Standalone reference accumulation measured longer than the entire operation; not valid phase attribution. Removed its benchmark and replaced it with actual routine timers. Initial throughput samples excluded from primary comparison because common harness changed before retained final baseline.",
            "raw_samples": samples("A1"),
            "log": (WORK / "A1.log").read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
        },
    },
    "limits": ["single Windows machine", "four processes per version", "no cross-library or complete-fit speed claim", "four heavy production tests not run"],
}
out = ROOT / "benchmarks/perf-tune-robust-covariance-2026-10-10.json"
out.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
for row in summary:
    print(row["case"], f'{row["baseline_us"]:.3f} -> {row["candidate_us"]:.3f} us, {row["reduction_percent"]:.1f}% reduction, CI {row["ratio_95_interval"]}')

    print("PHASE", cluster, {key: statistics.median(v[key] for v in values) / 1e6 for key in values[0]})
